text:
A deadly killer who thrives on eliminating targets.

Primary: DEX | Secondary: STR

MP mechanic: MP builds from kills (+20 per kill) - 5 kills = full Bloodlust. During Bloodlust, Execute resets on kill.

Skills:
Voidwalker - teleport behind + backstab
Death Blossom - AoE whirlwind
Execute - massive damage, instant kill below 20% HP
Coup de Grace - vault behind, double strike if mob turned
Bloodlust - kill-powered frenzy, speed + damage boost
Death Mark - mark target, detonates after 3 seconds
Garrote - silence + bleed from behind, requires mob turned
Eviscerate - 2.5x damage on bleeding targets
Venom Blade - next attack poisons + bleeds
Shadow Clone - dark decoy that attacks
Nightfall - AoE blind all nearby
Reaper's Kiss - passive, heal on each kill
Black Lotus - poison DoT, kill triggers chain explosion to nearby mobs
